purpose: Permanently record the one allowed no-return Tushare top10_floatholders entitlement, schema, identity, and concentration-formula acceptance outcome for the fixed three-session A-share research protocol.

source_selection_evidence.semantic_overlap_risk_frozen_before_rows: The candidate could be a near synonym of holder-count or major-holder concentration fields, so the contract required a no-return uniqueness rejection gate before any possible price access.

only_acceptance_attempt.invalid_field_scope: At least one of ts_code, ann_date, end_date, normalized holder_name, or hold_float_ratio failed completeness or finite-value validation in each counted invalid row.
only_acceptance_attempt.invalid_breakdown_note: All three response row counts were retained, but rejected raw frames and plaintext identities were deliberately not persisted. The strict canonicalizer aborted on the first response containing invalid rows, so a field-level or complete per-symbol validity breakdown is unavailable without a forbidden retry.
only_acceptance_attempt.failure_stage: after all three fixed requests and the first response's exact field-set check, but before holder-name hashing was published, holder-key uniqueness, ten-holder group completeness, first-version selection, consecutive-quarter concentration changes, full history, capacity, uniqueness, prices, or returns
only_acceptance_attempt.error: Tushare top10_floatholders response contains 2 incomplete or non-finite rows

interpretation.reason_for_terminal_stop: The frozen contract requires every requested key, holder identity, and circulating-share ratio to be complete and finite before a ten-holder concentration can be trusted. Two rows failed that rule, and the one-shot protocol forbids deleting them, filling them, changing the field set, or switching symbols or report dates after observing the response.

prohibited_actions: repeat top10_floatholders for any of the fixed symbols, another symbol, or another report-period range under this hypothesis
drop, fill, infer, or silently exclude either invalid row and accept the remaining response
replace hold_float_ratio with hold_ratio, hold_amount, hold_change, holder_type, or an identity-selected subset
persist or log plaintext holder identities to recover the rejected field breakdown
relax exact ten-holder completeness, use a later revision instead of the earliest complete disclosure, or bridge a missing quarter
change the factor formula, direction, event age, report window, minimum groups, capacity threshold, uniqueness threshold, holding period, TopK, costs, quality age, or listing gate
run full history, capacity, semantic uniqueness, return diagnostics, aggregation, current scoring, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2 intake from this branch
next_allowed_work: Start only from a genuinely independent economic mechanism under a new immutable no-return contract frozen before observing that source's rows; this rejected branch contributes no factor to any combination.
